scheduler_hint: Switching the scheduler off pauses every scheduled job.
error_unavailable: The orchestrator is not answering. Is it running?
error_timeout: The orchestrator took too long to answer.
error_denied: This screen is not allowed to ask for that.
error_orchestrator: The orchestrator answered with an error: {message}
error_unexpected: The reply was not what this card expects.
memory_similarity_off: Similarity is off: predictions are only the baseline.
memory_similarity_down: Similarity is unavailable: predictions are only the baseline.
memory_needs_reindex: {count} experiences need embedding for this model.
memory_score_failed: The score could not be read: {message}
memory_nothing_scored: Nothing scored yet: no resolved experience has a prediction.
memory_too_few: Too few to judge: {scored} scored, {needed} needed.
memory_brier: Brier score, lower is better: prediction {prediction}, baseline {baseline}.
memory_does_not_beat: Skill {skill}: does not beat the baseline.
knowledge_empty: The research base is empty: drop a file anywhere here, or add a note or a web address below.
knowledge_similarity_off: Similarity is off: search matches words only.
knowledge_similarity_down: Similarity is unavailable: search matches words only.
knowledge_none_relevant: No relevant match. These are the closest passages.
digest_no_sources: No source yet. Add a plugin to the feeds service and its items appear here.
digest_not_configured: The feeds service has no plugins directory (FEEDS_PLUGINS_DIR is not set).
digest_directory_error: The plugins directory cannot be read: {message}
digest_none_enabled: No source is enabled. Set "enabled": true in a plugin's manifest.
digest_at_limit: Showing the first {count}. The rest stays in the digest.
add_drop_hint: Drop the file to add it to the research base.
add_file_hint: Drop a file here or choose one: text, Markdown, HTML, Word, EPUB, PDF or a feed, up to {size} MB.
add_need_text: Write the text of the note.
add_title_too_long: The title is longer than {max} characters.
add_text_too_long: The text is longer than {max} characters.
add_bad_address: That is not a web address. Use one that starts with http:// or https://.
add_file_too_big: The file is larger than {size} MB.
add_file_unreadable: The file could not be read.
add_tag_too_long: A tag is longer than {max} characters.
add_updated: Updated the earlier version. Passages stored: {chunks}.
add_degraded: Not indexed by meaning yet, so for now it is found by keywords.
add_timeout: No answer in time. It may have been added; sending it again is safe.
add_reference_placeholder: such as a web address, or a book and page
add_id_hint: Leave it empty and the id is made from what you add. Giving an id that already exists replaces that document.
add_bad_kind: A kind is one lowercase word, such as note, article or book.
add_ref_too_long: The reference is longer than {max} characters.
add_bad_id: An id uses letters, digits and . _ : / # @ - (up to {max} characters).
document_rebuilt: Rebuilt from the passages the base stored: close to the original, not a faithful copy of it.
document_no_text: No text is stored for this document.
document_moved: The list changed since it was shown, so another document sits where this one was. Close this tab, load the list again and open the document from there.
documents_delete_timeout: No deletion reply. Reload documents to check before trying again.
index_timeout: No indexing reply. Refresh the counts before starting another batch.
index_degraded: Similarity indexing is unavailable. Keyword search still works.
communications_identity: Messages are sent as Ningo. Only configured channels appear here.
communications_no_content: Content unavailable. Check the bot's message content permission.
communications_uncertain: No delivery reply. Check the latest messages before sending again; it may already have arrived.
interfaces_hint: Switching an interface off stops it answering and receiving deliveries; its connection stays up.
link_steps: On the phone: WhatsApp > Settings > Linked devices > Link a device, then scan this code.
link_code_alt: Code to scan with the phone
communications_retention: The text of this conversation is kept on this machine for {days} days, then forgotten. Nothing else of it is kept.
communications_whatsapp_identity: Messages to a WhatsApp conversation go out from your own account, as you, as text only. A few a minute at most.
